inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,350 normalized lines of Atkinson's 1949 paper. Despite severe historical OCR damage in many displays, the prose supports a semantic chain from off-diagonal reindexing and Poisson/Voronoi continuation, through a general contour saddle-point lemma, to two oscillatory sums in an approximate functional equation for the critical-line mean square. Exact formulas and constants require verification from the retained scan.

sections_inspected.label: 1. Introduction and theorem
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Compares the zeta mean-square error with the divisor problem, states the two-sum approximate functional equation, and previews off-diagonal reindexing, Voronoi continuation, and saddle-point evaluation.

sections_inspected.label: 2-3. Meromorphic continuation of the off-diagonal series
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Separates diagonal and off-diagonal products, applies Poisson summation to the difference-index series, and analytically continues the auxiliary two-variable function to the critical case.

sections_inspected.label: 4. Voronoi continuation and integral decomposition
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Uses the divisor summation formula to continue the critical auxiliary function and decomposes the zeta mean square into four oscillatory integral contributions.

sections_inspected.label: 5. General saddle-point lemma
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Proves a uniform stationary-phase estimate by contour deformation, treating endpoints, nonstationary arcs, and the local Gaussian contribution separately.

sections_inspected.label: 6. Specialized oscillatory-integral lemma
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Specializes the general saddle lemma to the phases and amplitudes arising in the mean-square decomposition and calculates the stationary point and errors.

sections_inspected.label: 7. Estimation of I1 and I2
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Extracts the first oscillatory sum and shows the second integral is lower order.

sections_inspected.label: 8. Estimation of I3
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Splits at natural transition scales and combines mean-value estimates with the specialized saddle lemma to obtain the constant contribution and error.

sections_inspected.label: 9-10. Estimation of I4 and completion
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Applies a second saddle-point reduction to the Voronoi remainder, identifies the admissible stationary range, controls tails by partial summation, and obtains the second oscillatory sum.
